title: v4 pinned-profile manifest v1
description: Codifies the c14/c16-canonical shape enforced by agent-picks invariant (e). Schema is permissive of observed cross-cycle drift documented under invariant (d): (a) c9 bass_v2 uses 'operator_authority' rather than 'authority' in acceptance_fork; (b) c14 drums / c15 guitar use a nested object for 'chosen' rather than a plain string; (c) c15 guitar lacks top-level manifest_schema_version/agent/env_pin — these are RECOMMENDED but not required, so the schema validates what actually landed on disk. Schema still enforces: (i) required top-level identity fields; (ii) acceptance_fork presence with chosen + rejected + one-of {authority, operator_authority}; (iii) supersedes_path is str or null (c14 lemma), never list.

acceptance_fork.description: Invariant (e) canonical shape. Cross-cycle observed variants: c14 has {chosen,rejected,authority,invariants_doc}; c15 has {chosen,rejected,authority}; c9 (grandfathered) has {chosen,rejected,operator_authority,rationale}. Schema requires chosen+rejected + one-of {authority, operator_authority}.

supersedes_path.description: Per c14 lemma: str, not list. Nullable when no predecessor.
